question: Regarding the mechanical ventilation mode with pressure support or PSV (acronym in English "Pressure-Support Ventilation") it is true that:

options.opa: The respiratory rate and the "tidal" volume or current are determined by the doctor.
options.opb: The patient receives ventilatory assistance only when the ventilator detects an inspiratory effort.
options.opc: The most frequent complication of this ventilatory mode is barotrauma.
options.opd: It is the most frequent mode used at the beginning of mechanical ventilation because it ensures minute volume in patients who do not breathe spontaneously.
